summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by British American Tobacco p.l.c., a foreign private issuer, reporting a standard PDMR (Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities) share transaction under UK market rules. The filing discloses a purchase of 354 ordinary shares by a person closely associated with a PDMR at £43.90 per share on June 5, 2026. There is no corporate event, strategic action, or special-situation catalyst. It is a mandatory disclosure of internal dealings with no impact on shareholders, no premium, and no deal mechanics. No further action or analysis is warranted.
